synthesis.spiking_passes_exclusivity: Mutual exclusion: in each spiking frame, exactly one pass receives the ~0.9 ms latency penalty, while remaining passes execute at nominal latency.
synthesis.mi11x_comparison: Adreno 650 on Mi 11X does NOT exhibit the periodic 23-25 frame spike cadence. Frame times remain tightly bounded with standard deviation of only 0.12-0.14 ms and maximum frame time under 19.95 ms.
synthesis.root_cause_conclusion: SurfaceFlinger / Android Display Hardware Composer periodic composition preemption (5 Hz / 200 ms cadence). The GPU hardware context switch temporarily preempts the compute queue for ~0.9 ms, stalling whichever FSR3 pass is in-flight.
